title: Watchouts
slide_intent: Help editors recognize image treatments that can obscure the subject or make a documentary encounter look interchangeable.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can protect the specificity of its photographic record by keeping real settings, color and human detail visible.
demonstration: Six photographs marked with pink crosses demonstrate monochrome treatment, unclear focus, flash, stock imagery, artificial tinting and distance.
practical_value: Use the examples to explain a rejection precisely. Identify whether the problem is in the original shot, image selection or post-production.

content_islands.name: Selection note
content_islands.spec: Introduce the photographic exclusions in a short column beside the section rail.

content_islands.name: Rejected specimens
content_islands.spec: Set the six examples in a consistent two-by-three grid. Put a pink cross on every image and a short, distinct reason beneath each crop.
